description: Start an assessment on the user's computer, exactly like clicking "Start assessment" on the assessment page of the desktop app: starts with the given answer mode and role, opens the assessment overlay and tucks away the main window. Requires the desktop app to be running and signed in on the user's computer; if it is offline, an older version, short on balance, or an interview or assessment is already in progress, the reason is returned and nothing starts. Starting is free; each screenshot solved afterwards deducts the user's minutes by the chosen mode. Once started, the user uses the overlay on the assessment page as usual; solve_screen_question can also capture and solve. The assessment record is created on the first solved screenshot and can then be seen with list_exams. Uses the user's minutes or credits or creates a payment; tell the user what it costs and get their agreement first. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)

companyName.description: Company of the new role, given with jobName

goalId.description: Role (target) ID to link, from list_interview_targets; null = no role. Use either this or jobName; omit both to keep the role currently filled in on the assessment page of the app

jobName.description: Name of a new role, when the user has not saved it yet; it is created on start (same as typing a role on the assessment page)

mode.description: Answer mode: instant = Instant mode（2 minutes per screenshot）; quick = Quick mode（2 minutes per screenshot）; programming = Coding mode（5 minutes per question）. Members are not charged minutes. Omit to keep the mode currently selected on the assessment page of the app

name: start_exam
